hints.title: Three Candidate Letters Suffice
hints.text: A character has at most two neighbors (left and right). Testing three distinct letters guarantees finding one that matches neither neighbor.

hints.title: Single Pass Replacement
hints.text: Iterate through the string. When a question mark is encountered at index i, test "a", "b", and "c" in order.

hints.title: Boundary Neighbor Checks
hints.text: Check that candidate letter is not equal to the preceding character (if i > 0) and not equal to the succeeding character (if i + 1 < n).

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing letters a through z without restriction is unnecessary when 3 choices always suffice.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant neighbor comparisons take O(1) per character, running in O(N) time and memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate applies pigeonhole principle: 3 colors suffice for a degree-2 path graph.
complexity.notes: Any valid configuration with no adjacent duplicates is accepted.
